dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Observed 3-5 prominent irregular 'O' and 'C' shaped structures on the mid-lateral flank. These feature jagged, high-contrast dark perimeters with sharp, non-linear transitions to lighter interior fur. The largest central structure is an elongated 'C' shape with non-uniform perimeter thickness.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High spatial density of small, solid light-pixel clusters concentrated in the upper cervical region and dispersed among the annular structures on the posterior-lateral flank. These clusters lack internal gradients and exhibit high pixel intensity relative to the surrounding dark pelage.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three most prominent 'O' rings on the central-lateral flank form an irregular scalene triangle. A series of four high-intensity blobs along the dorsal ridge forms a semi-linear geometric relationship oriented longitudinally.
